about.intro: I'm a high school student who thrives at the intersection of leadership, innovation, and service. Whether it's organizing a recreational soccer league, competing at Odyssey of the Mind Worlds, or raising $1,000 for charity, I believe in taking initiative and making things happen.
highlights: Odyssey of the Mind World Finalist (2023 & 2024)
Boy Scouts of America - Troop 92, Milpitas
about.bio: Growing up in Milpitas, I've always been drawn to leadership roles and hands-on problem solving. From founding my school's Origami Club to organizing recreational sports leagues and competing in international STEM competitions, I've learned that the best way to create change is to take action. Every experience has taught me something new about teamwork, resilience, and the power of community.

faq.question: Who is Atharv Bagotra?
faq.answer: Atharv Bagotra is a high school student based in Milpitas, California, passionate about leadership, STEM, and community service.

faq.question: What competitions has Atharv participated in?
faq.answer: Atharv is an Odyssey of the Mind World Finalist (2023 & 2024) and a VEX Robotics State Finalist (2024).

faq.question: What roles has Atharv held?
faq.answer: Atharv served as Vice President of the Fundraising Committee at Curtner Student Council and is President of the Origami Club.

faq.question: What is Atharv involved in outside of school?
faq.answer: Atharv is a member of Boy Scouts of America Troop 92 in Milpitas, working toward his Tenderfoot rank, and competes in competitive soccer.
